info.title: OpenHire Phase 7 API
info.description: Compliance and analytics contracts. Staff requests derive tenant from authenticated claims. Browser BFF mutations additionally require X-XSRF-TOKEN and the session cookie. Internal routes are service-only, not public gateway routes. Flexible response objects reflect the map-based service views; detailed field definitions are in backend/docs/PHASE_7.md.
